stem: Red algae are multicellular photosynthetic protoctists that contain phycoerythrin. Phycoerythrin is a photosynthetic pigment.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem:
Fig. 4.1 shows:

• the absorption spectrum of phycoerythrin
• the action spectrum of red algae.

Fig. 4.1

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: With reference to Fig. 4.1, state the wavelength of peak absorption by phycoerythrin.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Explain how the data in Fig. 4.1 show that phycoerythrin is not the only photosynthetic pigment in red algae.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
Phycoerythrin is not the primary pigment (reaction centre pigment) for photosynthesis in red algae.

Suggest the role of phycoerythrin in photosynthesis in red algae.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Phycoerythrin is rarely found in plants that have green leaves.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State the name of a technique that can be used to separate and identify photosynthetic pigments.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain how the results of this technique would be used to confirm that phycoerythrin is present in red algae and not present in a plant with green leaves.
